# Organize an Email Inbox with AI

Turn an inbox backlog into reviewed groups and reversible labels while keeping important threads easy to find.

[Start this course on AILesson](https://ailesson.io/courses/organize-an-email-inbox-with-ai)

An inbox can look busy without showing what actually needs you. An old request may already be resolved; a quiet-looking reply may put the next move back in your hands. Sorting by the loudest subject line will not reliably separate them.

In this Course, you organize one small inbox backlog with AI. You give it your priorities, ask for groups you can check, inspect complete threads, and review a reversible label plan. Then you follow the recorded application to practice material and check that important threads remain findable.

AI helps with repeated reading and classification. You decide what matters, check the evidence behind a label, and keep unclear items visible. The same method works for a different inbox: supply your priorities and enough conversation context, review both the prominent items and the quiet pile, then verify the result of any changes.

You finish by reviewing an organized practice inbox and learning a method for checking a larger cleanup. This Course stays at the level of organizing threads; writing replies and carrying out the work inside those threads are separate tasks.

## Frequently asked questions

### Do I need to connect my email account?

No. The exercises use preset AI responses and a recorded local practice run. They require no email connection and make no changes to your real inbox.

### Do I need to bring my own backlog?

No. You receive 12 short, complete practice threads with no real personal or company data. When adapting the method later, use material you are allowed to share and remove unrelated private details while preserving the context needed to classify it.

### Will I finish with an empty inbox?

The goal is reliable organization. Important and unclear threads stay visible, and useful records remain retrievable. You review a practice change plan and its verification; you still decide whether and how to apply the method in your own email app.
